◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience is bored. Bored audiences stop watching. Stopped being watched is... we do not like to think about it. A trial, then. For you." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (You lived to tell it — twice — and now you see the pattern.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — tick: Keep two squares away. Keep 2+ squares away and it's harmless — it can't chase. Don't walk up to it. Latched: burn it off with fire, or let it feed full and drop on its own. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
